title: Hysab Kytab v1.0.8
message: Gemini AI Home Assistant bottom sheet, dual update options (in-app direct + browser Chrome download), persistent APK cache, and instant package installer.
changelog: Gemini AI floating bottom sheet popup for long-press Home button
Dual update choices: In-App Direct Update or Browser (Chrome) Download
Persistent APK detection: never re-downloads if file is already on device
Extended voice recognition with zero white system popups
